what: A third-party TrueHD decoder, run against the same six titles and against the authored master, to ask two things: whether the object presentation Dolby's software refuses on three of them opens elsewhere, and whether anything in oadec's object output disagrees with an implementation that shares none of its code

reference.independence: a separate codebase by other authors. It is not Dolby: two non-Dolby decoders agreeing is weaker evidence than either agreeing with Dolby, and this project already used it as the presentation-3 PCM baseline
reference.material: 25 MB from the head of each title, and the authored master of the controlled scene

result_1_the_refusal_is_not_in_the_strea.finding: truehdd opens presentation 3 on all six titles and exits 0, with the same element count oadec reports on each: 12, 16, 12, 12, 12 and 14. It reports Dolby Atmos true and an independent presentation 3 for all six, including the three that Dolby's object path refuses
result_1_the_refusal_is_not_in_the_strea.what_it_settles: a second implementation, sharing no code with this one, reads the three refused streams as ordinary object programmes. Dolby refuses and the stream is not an object programme are now separated by evidence rather than by assertion
result_1_the_refusal_is_not_in_the_strea.what_it_does_not_settle: why Dolby refuses. A permissive decoder opening a stream is not proof that a stricter one is wrong, and neither of the two that open it is Dolby. The reason stays open
result_1_the_refusal_is_not_in_the_strea.one_structural_difference_seen: Kingsman's presentation 1 is independent where the other five downmix it from presentation 2. It is one of the three refused, and the other two do not share it, so it separates nothing

result_2_the_audio_is_byte_identical.finding: on all six titles the two decoders' .atmos.audio files have the same MD5: same sample count, same channel count, same CAF header, zero differing samples
result_2_the_audio_is_byte_identical.why_that_is_expected: TrueHD is lossless and presentation 3 carries the objects as coded channels, so two correct decoders must agree exactly. It widens the existing presentation-3 gate from three titles to six

result_3_a_disagreement_in_metadata_timi.finding: the only field whose value differs is samplePos, and it differs by exactly 32 samples, never by anything else, in 131 of the 800 events written across the six titles and in 19 of the 45 of the authored scene. oadec's is always the later one
result_3_a_disagreement_in_metadata_timi.root_cause: truehdd computes the event position as sample_pos + sample_offset + evo_sample_offset (src/damf.rs:428) and never adds the block offset. It reads block_offset_factor_bits and uses it only to decide whether a payload restates the current state

the_normative_equation.clause: ETSI TS 103 420 V1.2.1 clause 5.3.2, Timing of property updates
the_normative_equation.text: The start_sample values t_n shall be determined by the following equation: t_n = so + 32 x bo_n. In this equation so is the value of sample_offset and bo_n is the value of block_offset_factor for the corresponding property update.
the_normative_equation.also: In the processing of each codec frame the decoder shall add the value 1 536 (the codec transform size in samples) to frame_offset.

the_arbiter_that_is_not_the_specificatio.method: take every written event position modulo 1536, the codec frame the clause names. A reading that is right should leave each stream on a coherent phase; a reading that drops a term should scatter the events that carry it

oadec.per_stream: one or two residues each, and the second is the one-per-element opening event

truehdd.per_stream: the same residues, with one of them split into two 32 apart

the_arbiter_that_is_not_the_specificatio.authored_scene: all 45 of oadec's event positions are exact multiples of 1536; 19 of truehdd's are 32 short of one. This is the case where a regular grid is expected, because the scene was authored and Dolby's encoder snapped its events to frame boundaries

result_3_a_disagreement_in_metadata_timi.verdict: a reference-decoder disagreement in which the specification is explicit and oadec follows it. Not an oadec defect, and not a reason to change anything here
result_3_a_disagreement_in_metadata_timi.limit_of_the_measurement: every stream measured carries block_offset_factor in 0 or 1 only, so the difference is always exactly 32 and the multiplier of 32 itself is normative rather than measured. A value above 1 has not been seen in any material
result_3_a_disagreement_in_metadata_timi.regression_test: crates/oadec-spatial/src/program.rs, an_update_starts_at_sample_offset_plus_thirty_two_per_block_factor, over seven combinations including block_offset_factor 63. Removing the term from the decoder makes it fail with left 0, right 32

result_4_positions_agree.finding: pos differs in printed form on 573 events and in value on none: the largest difference over all seven streams is 7,1e-08. truehdd prints the full double, oadec prints seven significant digits

authored-scene.title: the controlled scene, authored here and encoded by Dolby
